Team —

I just finished the final loop with Emily (candidate). Strong match for our infra + developer experience org. Two things to flag for calibration before I send the formal offer:

1) Leveling: Emily has ~7 years IC work and ~2 years managing a small SRE team (4 direct reports) at her last company. She told me she prefers a role that includes people management, but is open to an IC path if the scope/impact is bigger. Hiring manager (Aditya Rao) recommends L6 Manager given the org need to stand up a new backend team.

2) Compensation ask: Base target $210k, equity request 0.4% 4yr, sign-on $25k. These fall inside our L6 Manager band but at the upper quartile.

Requesting: sign-off on L6 Manager band + approval of one-time $25k sign-on (exception to standard $15k for L6, to secure candidate). Attached draft offer (Offer_Letters/Emily_Ross_L6_Manager.pdf) and JD (JD-Engineering-Manager-L6.pdf).

If we can't commit to manager title, alternate approach: L6 Senior IC with explicit 6-month manager-track plan and guaranteed role review at 6 months (promotion trigger tied to hiring 3rd headcount). That would change comp (slightly higher individual contributor equity curve).

Need decision by EOD Thursday 7/14 to meet candidate timeline. Please reply with: APPROVE (manager L6 + $25k sign-on) or COUNTER (specify) or NEED MORE INFO.

Thanks,

--

Thanks for the context. Quick calibration from the hiring committee side:

- L6 Manager bar: typically candidates have 3+ years direct people leadership at scale (managing managers or ~6+ direct reports at steady state). Emily's 2 years at smaller scale puts her in a borderline zone.
- Staff Engineer (L6 IC) vs L6 Manager: Staff IC is awarded for technical scope and cross-org influence. If Emily will be building core infra shared across squads and owning roadmap, Staff could fit. If the core deliverable includes direct reports and people ramp, manager makes sense.

Given product timelines, here's a recommended path that balances risk + retention:
- Offer L6 Manager title with standard L6 Manager comp (base $200k - $220k, equity 0.3-0.6%), include $25k sign-on approved as a hiring exception.
- Include a 6-month performance & scope review with success criteria (hiring 3rd hire or measurable system impact). If criteria met, convert sign-on to retention bonus (no clawback). If not met, standard clawback applies.

This preserves the title to get Emily onboard, while protecting us operationally. I see no need to classify as Staff at this point given hiring manager's roadmap.

Link to comp spreadsheet for reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CompSpreadsheetRedwood#EmilyRoss

-Jonas
Chair, Hiring Committee
